decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason:  In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be constructed in full accordance with the details of external materials previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2023/0443.  

Reasons:  To protect and enhance the character and appearance of the site and Grove Park Conservation Area in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and CC4.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the details shown in the proposed drawings hereby approved, the hereby permitted development's cycle storage facilities shall be implemented in full accordance with the design previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2023/2483 only, made available to occupants upon first occupation of the development and maintained as such thereafter without obstruction.  

Reasons:  To ensure adequate, secure and easily accessible cycle parking facilities are provided for the occupiers of the residential development to promote active and sustainable travel in accordance with London Plan Policy T5 and Local Plan Policy EC2.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall be constructed in full accordance with the Construction Phase Health, Safety & Environmental Plan previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2022/3139, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  

Reasons:  To protect the health and quality of the local environment, highway safety and accessibility and neighbour living conditions in accordance with Local Plan Policies EQ4, EQ5, EQ7 and EC2 and London Plan Policies D14, SI1, SI8 and T7.

Condition : 5 - A.	The development hereby permitted shall be implemented in full accordance with the approved Sustainability Report (Ref:  PA1584 (Rev C)), received 28 September 2021.  

B.	Prior to the first occupation of any dwelling within the development hereby permitted, evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built Certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure/ National Calculation Method) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Sustainability Report (Ref:  PA1584 (Rev C)), and any subsequent approved revisions.  

Reason:  To ensure the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions contributing to climate change in accordance with London Plan Policy SI2 and Local Plan Policy EQ1.

Condition : 6 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufacturers' literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105 litres per person per day or less.  

Reasons:  To protect and conserve water supplies and resources in accordance with London Plan Policy SI5 and Local Plan Policy EQ2.

Condition : 7 - The development shall be implemented in full accordance with the sustainable material details previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2023/3710 only.  

At least 50% of timber and timber products used in the construction of the development hereby permitted shall be accredited by the Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.  

No construction or insulation materials shall be used that would release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.  

Reasons:  To ensure the sustainable sourcing of materials in accordance with London Plan Policy SI2 and the Mayor of London's Sustainable Design and Construction SPG.

Condition : 8 - Notwithstanding the details shown in the proposed drawings hereby approved, the development hereby permitted shall be implemented in full accordance with the final detailed drainage design, modelling calculations and drainage assessment form previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2022/3377.  

Reasons:  To mitigate and prevent the risk of flooding to and from the site in accordance with London Plan Policies SI12 and SI13, Local Plan Policy EQ3 and the Mayor of London's Sustainable Design and Construction SPG.

Condition : 9 - No part of the development hereby permitted shall be occupied until evidence (photographs, copies of installation contracts and written confirmation) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme has been constructed in accordance with the final detailed drainage design previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2022/3377.  
The implemented sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the SUDS Maintenance & Operation Plan for all drainage scheme components previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2022/3377.  

Reason:  To mitigate and prevent surface water flood risk in accordance with London Plan Policies SI12 and SI13, Local Plan Policy EQ3 and the Mayor of London's Sustainable Design and Construction SPG.

Condition : 10 - Before the development hereby permitted commences:

b.	The site shall be remediated and the development hereby permitted shall be constructed in full accordance with the Remediation Method Statement (Ref:  B2633.03/23/RMS) previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2022/3108.  

During the course of the development:

c.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if any additional land contamination is discovered during the course of the development.  A competent person shall assess the additional contamination and submit appropriate amendments to the previously approved decontamination scheme in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.  

Before the development is first brought into use:

d.	The agreed decontamination scheme referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.  

Reasons:  Land contamination is known or suspected within the site due to a former land use.  The Local Planning Authority therefore wishes to ensure that the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public and environmental safety, in accordance with Local Plan Policy EQ8.  

Supporting Notes:

�	In some instances, the Local Planning Authority may require work on site to be ceased whilst the nature of any additional land contamination is investigated fully.  
�	The validation report shall revisit the site's conceptual model and provide evidence that each aspect of the decontamination scheme has been carried out correctly and successfully.  This report shall prove that the development is suitable for its new use.  
�	We request that site investigation reports or site plans be sent electronically to landquality@hounslow.gov.uk or by post on a CD or DVD wherever possible.

Condition : 11 - The development hereby permitted shall obtain a 'Secured by Design' certificate before it is first occupied and permanently continue to meet the certified standard.  

Reason:  To enhance neighbourhood safety in accordance with Local Plan Policy CC2.

Condition : 12 - Before first occupation of the development hereby permitted, a waste and recycling store shall be implemented and made available for use in accordance with the design details previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2023/2483 and thereafter be maintained as such, without obstruction, for the duration of the development.  

Reason:  To ensure suitable waste storage facilities are provided and maintained in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC2 and EQ7.

Condition : 13 - In this condition, 'retained tree' means any existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved drawings and particulars, and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of five years from the date of the occupation of any of the buildings hereby approved.  

(a) No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard 3998 (Tree Work) or any other British Standard replacing this.  

(b) If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  

Reason:  To ensure the protection of retained trees from damage, in the interests of visual amenity, in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and GB7.

Condition : 14 - Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, the two disabled car parking bays shown in the proposed drawings hereby approved shall be implemented in accordance with the design details (following receipt by the Local Planning Authority of a secured financial payment from the applicant) previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2023/0653, and be permanently maintained as such thereafter.  

The two car parking bays shall be made permanently available for use by disabled drivers and no other purpose.  

Reason:  To ensure that there are adequate disabled car parking spaces adjoining the site to achieve an inclusive residential development and protect highway safety in accordance with Local Plan Policy EC2.

Condition : 15 - Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, the two disabled car parking bays shown in the proposed drawings hereby approved shall be implemented in accordance with the design details (following receipt by the Local Planning Authority of a secured financial payment from the applicant) previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2023/0653, and be permanently maintained as such thereafter.  

The two car parking bays shall be made permanently available for use by disabled drivers and no other purpose.  

Reason:  To ensure that there are adequate disabled car parking spaces adjoining the site to achieve an inclusive residential development and protect highway safety in accordance with Local Plan Policy EC2.

Condition : 16 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the existing vehicular accesses to Station Approach Road shall be permanently closed and the footway/ kerb reinstated and raised, and a conventional vehicular access shall be provided.  The access shall be constructed in accordance with the Local Highway Authority's specification before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use.  

Reason:  To enhance the pedestrian environment and provide vehicular access to the permitted points only to ensure that the development would not prejudice the free flow of traffic or highway safety along the adjacent highway in accordance with Local Plan Policy EC2.

Condition : 17 - Prior to the first occupation of the development, the two Active Electric Vehicle Charging Points (each capable of a minimum output of 7.2kW) shall be installed adjacent to the site in Station Approach Road in accordance with the design details (following receipt by the Local Planning Authority of a secured financial payment from the applicant) previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2023/0653, and be permanently maintained as such thereafter.  
Reasons:  To promote clean and sustainable modes of transport and contribute to improving local air quality in accordance with Local Plan Policies EQ4 and EC2.
